passage.label: Woe those give less than due; when take measure people take full; if give measure weight cause loss; do they not think resurrected; tremendous Day; Day mankind stand before Lord worlds

arabicExcerpts.text: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ

mainSubject.label: Woe pronounced on those who give less than due — taking full measure from people yet causing loss when measuring or weighing for them; their failure to consider resurrection for a tremendous Day when all mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds

subordinateSubjects.label: Woe pronounced on those who give less than due
Taking full measure when receiving from people
Yet causing loss when measuring or weighing for them
Their failure to consider that they will be resurrected
The Day mankind stands before the Lord of the worlds

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Woe to those who give less than due — taking full measure from people while causing loss when giving.

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Commercial double standard rooted in failure to consider resurrection

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Fraudulent measuring and weighing condemned as economic injustice

relationships.label: All mankind standing before the Lord of the worlds on a tremendous Day

terminology.gloss: those who give less than due (editorial gloss)

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the standing-before-the-Lord statement (6) before the Sijjeen record block opens (7); P2 ends with the this-is-what-you-denied declaration (17) before the Illiyyun record block begins (18); P3 runs through the inscribed register, couch-radiance, sealed wine and Tasneem spring (18-28); P4 covers the criminal-mockery catalogue and its eschatological reversal (29-36).
